checks: Committed snapshot reconstructed from both M10K write sources, exact read/packet payload checks, no raw reads or snapshot writes after detachment, and real legacy raw work concurrent with old output while completed sequence remains unchanged.

Every actual CPU LOAD plus explicit contiguous GROUP members reproduces all original calls; physical descriptor snapshot equals every accepted descriptor pair, and immutable VTX/TRI ELF bytes equal member-source snapshots.

Independent per-member dead-slot proof, complete atomic context before every request, actual protected context RAM writes and restored values, and all raw inputs equal the same-ELF reference by logical LOAD identity.
Every ordinary input word forwarded exactly; every generated packet stored within owning task; output bytes bind actual FIFO handshakes.

AJ03 priority grants before requested-prefix completion; indivisible full-context/request and restored member ownership; legacy lease acquire/grant/release and repair token ACK/DATA/END checks; matching complete sequences and no outstanding ownership at final boundary.

normalization: Only known framebuffer bases/flip indices, the one prepared zero-clear, known s5 timestamp at later frame entries and redundant sticky material/vertex preparation. Every actual indexed draw resolves exact vertex payload and material/object state; other side effects retain exact order. Registers/FCSR otherwise remain strict.
limitations: Two prepared, GPU-drained full game/render/audio intervals on actual native CPU and raster RTL.
Fixed synthetic display/audio arrivals and bounded service implementations; not sustained Pocket FPS or full OS/PCM/interrupt qualification.
No ideal producer, instruction-cost subtraction or assumed overlap is credited as a frame-time gain.
Physical area, timing and hardware behavior require separate qualification after measured benefit.
